sections.title: New places, close to home
sections.content: Two new nouns for the streets around you: *sarok* ("corner") and *szomszédság* ("neighbourhood"). You know *pékség* ("bakery") and *templom* ("church") from A1. *szomszédság* is built on *szomszéd*, the *szomszéd* you already know, plus *-ság* — the same way *barátság* would be "friendship".

items.english: The bakery is on the corner.

sections.content: *a sarkon* uses *-on*, the superessive suffix — "on the corner" is a fixed, natural chunk in both Hungarian and English.
